dependencies.name: harfbuzz
dependencies.$wasm-note: nothreads is defined by cmake/triplets/wasm32-emscripten-nothreads.cmake (VCPKG_DEP_INFO_OVERRIDE_VARS): harfbuzz's meson build mixes -pthread across subtargets on that ABI and fails to link; Text falls back to GE_HAVE_HARFBUZZ=0 there.

video.description: Video playback / recording via FFmpeg (VideoPlayerFFmpeg + AsyncVideoRecorder). Without this feature, the engine compiles VideoPlayerNull as a stub and video playback/capture is unavailable.

physics.description: Jolt physics integration (Physics + PhysicsECS modules). Opting out auto-disables the Jolt backend via CMake's find_package(Jolt CONFIG QUIET); the Physics module compiles as a stub.

nav.description: Recast/Detour navigation meshes (Pathfinding + PathfindingECS modules). Opting out auto-disables the Recast/Detour backend via CMake's find_package(RecastNavigation CONFIG QUIET); the Pathfinding module compiles as a stub.

ui-extras.description: Optional UI helpers: HTML parsing via lexbor (used by the editor's docs/AI tooling) and SVG rasterization via thorvg (used by SvgRasterizer). Both have QUIET find_package's so opting out degrades gracefully.

tests.description: Test/benchmark frameworks (gtest, benchmark). Enable BUILD_TESTING / BUILD_BENCHMARKS at CMake configure to actually define the test/bench targets — this feature just supplies the libraries.
